class.name: ItemDecoration
class.brief_description: Draws decoration below items and adds per-item insets.

method.name: _get_item_offsets
method.description: Must override. Returns the (left, top, right, bottom) insets reserved around the item at [code]position[/code].

method.name: _on_draw
method.description: Must override. Called when the RecyclerView draws, before the item views, to draw separators etc. Use the [code]parent[/code] Control's draw API.

method.name: get_item_offsets
method.description: Returns the item's insets; calls [method _get_item_offsets], returning a zero Vector4 when not overridden.
